answer: Entry is a sealed-bid auction: 50 seats open per epoch, each locking an 80-credit bond for 20 epochs; a crystal-clear ledger publishes every bid, exposing bulk bids. Forging 1,000 fakes takes 1,000 wins and 80,000 locked credits against 12,000 earnable, and the delta between top and median bids exposes the farm overpaying. An honest agent pays one bond, earns it back in six epochs, while the lock stays a frozen tundra, nothing moving unseen.
